column1: # Which PR a check of the oracle proves: check id, then the PR (PR#n on the fork,
# POI#n on the installer fork). Read by sharukhan (SHARUKHAN_CHECK_PRS, default
# $SHARUKHAN_ROOT/config/check-prs.tsv); a check without a line is attributed to no
# PR. `sharukhan doctor` warns about a PR here that is no longer open.
